name: diag_g01_metadata_cpu_report_01
command:
import json,pathlib,re
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
r=pathlib.Path.cwd(); checked=[]
for n,expected in [('g01_construction_metadata_cpu_01',7),('g01_construction_metadata_regression_01',620)]:
 d,ref=audited_result(r/'results'/f'{n}.json');assert d['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and d['metrics']['command_exit_code']==0
 text=(r/'logs/runs'/f'{n}.log').read_text();counts=re.findall(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([\d.]+)s',text);assert counts and int(counts[-1][0])==expected
 checked.append({'result':ref,'tests':int(counts[-1][0]),'suite_seconds':float(counts[-1][1]),'passed':True})
a,ar=audited_result(r/'results/g01_concurrency_final_accounting_01.json');assert a['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and a['metrics']['complete_allocation_accounting']
note='\n### Original construction metadata retention fixed for future runs\n\n'
note+='After all 18 G01 benchmark children ended, commit 53865bf adds a separate bounded reserve for original Controller scene_preflight.json/evidence_index.json only (16 MiB/file,64 MiB/scene). It does not reconstruct old missing files, fund scientific payloads after the existing raw cap, or change independent acceptance. Metadata IO/limit failures remain explicit. Logged CPU validation: '+json.dumps(checked,sort_keys=True)+'.\n\n'
note+='G01 benchmark PBS 707841 actual allocation/chargedGPUh at current scheduler multiplier1: '+str(a['metrics']['total_allocation_gpu_hours'])+'; recorded queue wait '+str(a['metrics']['queue_wait_seconds_by_job']['707841.hopper-m-02'])+' seconds. Original incomplete/deadline records remain; source-reported candidates are not independently accepted.\n'
with (r/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write(note)
print('METADATA_FIX_VALIDATION: '+json.dumps({'tests':checked,'accounting':ar,'metrics':a['metrics']},sort_keys=True))
